Ana Chen: Quick sync — Covex renewal next Tuesday. They asked for an SLA evidence bundle showing uptime for the last 90d + p95 latency for /v1/generate. Can we collate this and pre-calculate any potential credits?
Tom Ruiz: I can pull the uptime numbers. Will reuse the 'uptime_events' query from last quarter.
Priya Kapoor: I’ll run the p95 for /v1/generate and check tail latency regressions. Expect results by EOD.
Ana Chen: Thanks. Target thresholds we agreed on: 99.95% uptime, p95 < 350ms. If observed_uptime < 99.95% we need the credit calc ready.
Emma Park: Can support prep the customer-facing PDF and include the runbook excerpt for incident timelines? I can draft wording.
Liam O'Neill: Covex flagged renewal risk if credits look big. We should show mitigations (canary + autoscale settings) alongside numbers.
Tom Ruiz: Sharing the SQL I’ll use for uptime (copy/paste):
```sql
-- uptime across last 90d
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day,
  SUM(case when status = 'up' then 1 else 0 end)::float / COUNT(*) * 100 as uptime_pct
FROM metrics.uptime_events
WHERE service = 'api-gateway' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY day;
```
Priya Kapoor: For p95 I’ll run this on the latency table and compare canary vs prod:
```sql
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95
FROM metrics.request_latency
WHERE route = '/v1/generate' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days';
```
Ana Chen: For credits calc I propose we use a simple, transparent formula and show worked example. e.g.:
```
# example
credit = max(0, floor((99.95 - observed_uptime) * 1000)) * $100
# so 99.80% -> (99.95-99.80)=0.15 -> floor(0.15*1000)=150 -> $15,000
```
Emma Park: That example is super helpful. I’ll add a small table with 99.95/99.90/99.80 rows.

Tom Ruiz: Raw numbers: pulling now. Will post CSV link in thread when ready.
Priya Kapoor: p95 run finished: prod p95=370ms, canary p95=330ms. Will re-run with 30d window as a sensitivity check.
Ana Chen: Ok — Priya, can you re-run 30d and 14d and post both? Tom, add a note if any full-day outages contributed to the delta. Emma, draft the PDF and include the credit formula + mitigations section.
Liam O'Neill: If 30d looks better we can present the 90d as conservative, 30d as recent trend. That helps renewals.
Tom Ruiz: Uploaded CSV: https://redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/covex_uptime_90d.csv :thumbsup:
Priya Kapoor: 30d p95=345ms, 14d p95=340ms. I'm attaching a short note on a noisy background job that spiked in week 6.
Emma Park: Draft done — attaching PDF draft link: https://drive.redwood/workspace/covex_sla_bundle_draft.pdf. I included the canary/autoscale table and next steps.
Ana Chen: Perfect. Action items: Tom deliver final uptime table + anomaly notes; Priya deliver p95s + incident blurb; Emma finalize PDF; I’ll send to Covex and propose a 30-min walkthrough before renewal call.
Tom Ruiz: On it.
Priya Kapoor: Will post final numbers by 17:00 PT.
Emma Park: Targeting PDF final by noon tomorrow.
Ana Chen: Thanks team. If anyone spots any unexpected degradations in the 90d data ping me immediately. :pray:
